text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, while integration tests make sure that different parts of the system work together correctly. Test-driven development is a method where developers write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Although writing tests takes extra time, it brings great benefits. Regular testing gives developers confidence that their changes will not break existing features. It also makes it easier to find and fix problems early, before they reach users. In short, testing is not a waste of time but a smart investment in quality.
